clauses.title: Formal gate results travel as a structured envelope
requires: Every formal Sol and Terra invocation in both workflow roots
`outputSchema`
every Issue, PR review-only, and exact-autofix route passes the envelope
packaged `gate_result_validate` before reading any field
`outputSchema` alone is insufficient
parent's verdict, correlation, finding, confirmation, and decision authority
never parse those fields from Markdown
final-line token `MERGE | FIX BEFORE MERGE | NEEDS DECISION`
complete assigned `{findingId, blockerKey}` tuples
the fresh finding namespace is derived, never supplied
after validated intake the parent assigns `blockerKey`
Issue records carry only candidate identity, fixed revised passage, and snapshot assignment
PR records select `gate | body | issue-comment | review | inline-comment | check | status`
incompatible variant fields fail closed
exact required evidence-attestation set
each counterexample or unavailable-evidence result links to its finding
material evidence cannot simultaneously confirm that finding as fixed
without weakening CL-D34's explicitly non-blocking follow-up/out-of-scope classes
is a tool failure that consumes no counter and is never a verdict

clauses.title: The packaged validator is bound to every gate result
requires: every Issue, PR review-only, and exact-autofix route
packaged `gate_result_validate` before reading any field

clauses.title: The authority baseline is raised by owner decision
clauses.section: ## CL-D36 — Formal gate results travel as a strict structured envelope
requires: Raise the six-file authority baseline from 108,000 to 112,000 bytes
The byte baseline is a review guard, not a target
